# bob prose

Format and inspect prose notes with bob-owned section numbers

```text title="bob prose --help"
Format, inspect, extract, and inline prose notes (frontmatter type: "[[prose]]").

Every `bob prose` command reads or rewrites prose notes. `[[article]]` notes still count. bob owns their section numbers (1. / 1.1 / 1.1.1) and layout; formatting never changes a word. Bare `bob prose` runs the read-only `list` command.

Usage: bob prose [OPTIONS]
       bob prose <COMMAND>

Commands:
  adopt    Mark a note as a prose note; preview unless --write
  format   Number sections and tidy layout in prose notes
  list     List prose notes with sections, TODO stubs, and findings
  outline  Print a prose note's numbered section outline
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <PATH>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  bob prose                                      List prose notes
  bob prose adopt sase_blog_contents             Preview adopting a note
  bob prose adopt -w sase_blog_contents          Adopt it
  bob prose format sase_blog_contents            Format one prose note
  bob prose format -n off sase_blog_contents     Turn section numbers off
  bob prose format -a -c                         Check all prose notes
  bob prose outline sase_blog_contents           Numbered outline with word counts

See docs/prose.md for the rules and JSON contract.
```
